headline: Housing Credit Becomes More Expensive Again in Madeira With Interest Rate Rise
summary: The implicit interest rate on housing credit in Madeira rose to 3.208% in July, up 0.046 percentage points from the previous month, according to INE and DREM data.
why: Implicit mortgage rates track the average cost of housing loans, which affects household borrowing costs and demand in the regional property market.
